en: A vintage-style postcard featuring a sepia-toned illustration of a busy harbor with sailing ships and boats. The foreground shows several large ships with masts, and smaller boats carrying people. In the distance, more ships and waterfront buildings are visible. The caption under the image reads 'Göteborgs hamn på 1850-talet efter målning av C. F. Sörensen'. The bottom margin includes identifiers and credits in Swedish.
